playbookOutputs: Share certificate(s) (PDF, numbered, signed by the directors)
Director resolution approving the issue or transfer
Updated entry for the securities register
playbookCommonFailures: Number of shares to be issued exceeds the authorised shares in the MOI
Shareholder's full names or ID number differ between the instruction and the ID document
A transfer is requested but the previous certificate number and transferor are not supplied
Certificate signed by only one director when the MOI requires two signatories
Client is a close corporation — CCs have member interests, not shares, and need a CK2 amendment instead

informationToProvide.label: Company name and registration number (CK number)
Company registration certificate (COR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 or MOI showing the registration number, registered name and directors who will sign the certificate. If it is a CK1/CK2 (close corporation) stop — CCs do not issue share certificates.

informationToProvide.label: Copy of company Memorandum of Incorporation (MOI)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Registered MOI (CoR15.1A or customised) showing the authorised number and classes of shares. Extract the authorised share count and any class rights.

informationToProvide.label: Details of shareholders (full names, ID numbers/company registration numbers)
informationToProvide.helpText: For each shareholder receiving a certificate: full legal names as on ID, ID or registration number, and address.

informationToProvide.label: ID copy of each shareholder
informationToProvide.aiHint: Clear copy of the SA ID or passport (or CoR14.3 for a corporate shareholder) so the names and numbers on the certificate match exactly. Certification not required for this service.

informationToProvide.label: Number and class of shares being issued or transferred
informationToProvide.helpText: E.g. 100 ordinary no-par-value shares to each shareholder; state whether this is a new issue or a transfer.

informationToProvide.label: Previous share certificate details (if applicable, for transfers)
informationToProvide.helpText: Certificate number, transferor and number of shares being transferred.

informationToProvide.label: Existing share certificates or securities register (if any)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Existing certificates or register, used to continue the certificate numbering and confirm the transferor holds the shares.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect company documents and shareholder / share details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, MOI, shareholder details with IDs, share numbers/class and (for transfers) previous certificate details received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask whether this is a first issue (new company), a further allotment or a transfer between people — the paperwork differs. Ask for names exactly as on the ID. Turnaround 1-2 working days; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify share numbers against the MOI and identities
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Issued + to-be-issued shares do not exceed authorised shares; names and ID numbers match IDs; certificate numbering continues correctly
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Extract the authorised shares from the MOI. Total shares in issue after this transaction must not exceed it — if it does, flag: the MOI must be amended (CoR15.2) first. For transfers, confirm the transferor appears on an existing certificate / register. Check the MOI for the number of signatories required on a certificate (default: two directors, or one director plus the company secretary; a sole director signs alone).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft share certificate(s) and director resolution
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: One certificate per shareholder and a resolution approving the allotment / transfer drafted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Certificate content (s51 Companies Act): company name and registration number, certificate number, shareholder's full names and ID/registration number, number and class of shares, date of issue, statement of any restrictions on transfer per the MOI, and signature lines for the required directors. For a transfer, note 'issued in replacement of certificate no. X' and draft the transfer entry. Never round or guess share numbers.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send certificate(s) and resolution to directors for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that the directors sign the certificate and the resolution, and that the original certificate belongs to the shareholder while the company keeps a copy in its register. Return as PDF.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver signed share certificate(s) and register entry
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed certificates, resolution and register entry posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Advise safekeeping and that CIPC's beneficial ownership register must be updated if ownership changed — offer the Beneficial Ownership Declaration and Share Register services.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
